roadStops.title: The whispering mystery box
roadStops.description: Open a sealed box: treasure, a trick, or a mini-game. You may leave it sealed.

roadStops.title: The crumbling crossing
roadStops.description: Time your crossing, spend a clue, or take a safe one-tile detour.

roadStops.title: The travelling arcade
roadStops.description: A road spirit opens one of ten mini-games. Win points and gold.

roadStops.title: The bard’s dare
roadStops.description: Try a playful storytelling dare, take a rune challenge instead, or pass.

roadStops.title: The dragon’s guarded hoard
roadStops.description: A dragon guards this tile. Face its trial, pay a toll, or retreat one tile.

roadStops.title: The warding shrine
roadStops.description: Gain a ward that absorbs the next danger, or discover a clue.

roadStops.title: The moonlit lockbox
roadStops.description: A second sealed box hums beside the path. Its contents change every opening.

roadStops.title: The stormglass ravine
roadStops.description: Keep your balance, use a clue, or choose a safe detour.

roadStops.title: The runekeeper’s games
roadStops.description: Test your memory, timing, reasoning, or route finding.

roadStops.title: The mischievous hex
roadStops.description: Break the hex in a trial or accept a slower next roll in exchange for a clue.

roadStops.title: The skywarden’s challenge
roadStops.description: A winged guardian watches this passage. Win its trial for a shortcut.

roadStops.title: The lantern dare
roadStops.description: Invent a tiny legend for your hero, choose a puzzle, or simply pass.

roadStops.title: The wayfarer’s camp
roadStops.description: Rest by the fire. Recover gold or remove a lingering hex.

roadStops.title: The final puzzle pavilion
roadStops.description: One last invitation to earn points before the destination.

roadStops.title: The starfall coffer
roadStops.description: The last mystery box: golden luck, a mimic’s trick, or a skill trial.

roadStops.title: The elder at the gate
roadStops.description: The elder guards the approach to the finish. A brave trial can carry you onward.

roadStops.title: The last falling stones
roadStops.description: Watch your footing. A failed crossing sends you back, but a ward protects you.
